thread:
mira: Hi all 1: just started today. Quick map needed: who do I ping for (1) dev GPU access, (2) adding to PagerDuty, (3) secrets/KMS access, and (4) whos the onboarding buddy for infra/runtime?

tom: welcome Mira! :wave: short map: (1) infra grants dev-gpu (link: https://redwood.internal/access-request -> select 'dev-gpu'); (2) people-ops handles PagerDuty additions after shadowing; (3) eng-security owns KMS/secrets requests; (4) onboarding buddy is assigned by your manager, typically someone from your team for 2 weeks.

nina: extra detail: for secrets/KMS requests include service name and justification. Eng-security will do a quick review and tag infra if provisioning is needed. For immediate read-only secrets, request "secrets-reader" role.

mira: thanks! who should I page if a model deployment is failing vs if nodes are OOMing?

tom: rule of thumb: model process errors -> page eng-runtime on-call. Node/k8s/oz infra -> page eng-sre. Rollout/config issues -> eng-platform. If it's across areas, page both and tag a platform lead like @nina.

onboarding-bot: Helpful links: runbooks index: https://redwood.internal/runbooks | new-hire oncall checklist: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/new-hire-checklist.md

nina: escalation timing we use: 0-5m ack expected from primary on-call; 5-10m escalate to secondary; 15m -> incident commander. Security/compliance incidents: page eng-security immediately and avoid posting payloads.

mira: perfect. one more: is there a public doc for "who owns what" (owner matrix)?

tom: yes, ownership matrix is in the handbook: https://redwood.internal/handbook/ownership-matrix. It lists primary owners, secondary owners, and contacts for cross-team flows. Also we maintain a small "who-to-ask" doc in /docs/new-hires linking runbooks and owners.

mira: great, I'll fill the access form and DM my manager about a buddy. thanks everyone! :raised_hands: 

onboarding-bot: Note: PagerDuty additions require manager approval + 1-2 weeks of shadowing. See: https://redwood.internal/pagerduty-policy

nina: ping me if you want a quick 20-min runbook walkthrough later today, happy to help.

mira: will do, thanks :)
